title: Elastic Carousel
subtitle: Responsive standards review
summary: Three responsive rules need review to meet the shared block CSS standard.
interpretation: The carousel already uses the standard tablet and desktop boundaries. The remaining work concerns mobile-first structure and the reasons for bounded layouts. Customer impact has not been established by this audit.
recommendation: Assign a joint design and engineering review, then use this block as a pilot for enforcing responsive standards in CI.

decisions.title: Make mobile behavior the starting point
decisions.body: Move the stacked mobile layout into base styles, then layer on tablet and desktop changes. Verify that the refactor preserves the intended experience.
decisions.evidence: Stacked, sticky cards are implemented inside an upper-bound query. The policy expects the mobile layout in the unqueried base.

decisions.title: Confirm the tablet-only layout
decisions.body: Review the tablet-specific height, card width, and padding. Document the reflow need or express the change progressively at standard breakpoints.
decisions.evidence: The boundaries match MD and LG, but the range is limited to tablet widths. It needs a specific reflow rationale or a mobile-first refactor.

decisions.title: Validate the 1700px transition
decisions.body: Measure the carousel’s centering and edge positioning around 1700px. Retain this custom boundary only if the layout requires it and the exception is documented.
decisions.evidence: This rule changes horizontal positioning below 1700px. Both its bounded form and its nonstandard upper threshold are flagged; the layout rationale needs review.
